findings.issue: Plain text secrets in user data
findings.risk: AWS credentials are hardcoded in the user data script, which can be exposed if the instance metadata is accessed
findings.remediation: Use AWS Secrets Manager or environment variables to handle sensitive data instead of hardcoding in user data

findings.risk: Data at rest on the EBS volume is not encrypted, posing a risk if the volume is accessed by unauthorized entities
findings.remediation: Set the `encrypted` attribute to `true` and provide a `kms_key_id` for the encryption

findings.risk: Data in the EBS snapshot is not encrypted, which can be accessed if the snapshot is compromised
findings.remediation: Set the `encrypted` attribute to `true` and provide a `kms_key_id` for the encryption

findings.issue: Security group open to the world on SSH port
findings.risk: Allowing all IP addresses to access the SSH port can lead to unauthorized access to the instance
findings.remediation: Restrict the `cidr_blocks` in the ingress rule for port 22 to only trusted IP ranges
